app.title: TacticLab · Match analysis
app.description: Interactive football tactics analysis using synthetic match data.
error.match: Could not load the match. Please check that the backend is running.
error.explanation: The explanation is currently unavailable. Please try again.
method: Synthetic tracking · Tactical findings are rule-based, time-confirmed observations. Historical markings do not represent current player positions.
comparisonNote: Two equal periods of the replay watched so far.
chartLabel: Progressive passes: first period {first}, second period {second}
azureEnabled: Azure enabled · requests may incur costs
controls: Scroll: zoom · Drag: pan · Click: select player
pitchLabel: Animated football pitch. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan; click a player or use the player selector.
emptyPlayer: No confirmed tactical finding for this player yet.
emptyEscapes: No confirmed tactical finding for these filters yet. Detection waits for spatial evidence and retained possession.
detectionRule: An opponent is within 10 m at release; the pass advances at least 10 m. At least one pressing opponent is bypassed by 2 m. At reception the nearest opponent is at least 8 m away, a gain of at least 2 m in space. After 2 s the ball is controlled in the same possession phase.
overlayKey: Marking: historical pass trace and bypassed opponents · {start}–{end}

attempts.one: {count} pass attempt in the replay so far
attempts.other: {count} pass attempts in the replay so far

liveReplayNote: Pause and rewind affect only your view. Incoming frames continue to fill the replay buffer.
expiredNote: Received moments remain available for replay and analysis. Start a new simulation to go live again.
exportHint: JSON report at the current replay time
eventsThrough: Completed events up to {time}. Select an event to inspect it on the pitch.
noEventsHint: Adjust the filters or move forward in the match. Only events already reached in replay appear here.
localNotes: Saved in this browser for this scenario. Notes are included in report exports.
temporaryNotes: Browser storage is unavailable. Notes will be lost on reload; export a report to keep them.
notePlaceholder: What matters in this moment? Add a tactical observation…
noScenesHint: Use Save moment to keep the current time, selected player and your observations.
scenePendingHint: This saved moment becomes available when the live stream reaches it.
notebookFull: Notebook limit reached. Delete a scene to save another.
switchRule: Successful pass between opposite outer thirds of the 68 m pitch; at least 34 m lateral shift, no more than 10 m backwards, at least 8 m space at reception. Controlled possession in the same phase after 2 s.
overloadRule: After a successful reception, at least 3 attackers and 1 defender within a fixed 15 m radius. Attackers outnumber defenders at every tracking and possession-transition sample for 2 s; the ball carrier remains controlled inside the zone in the same phase. Overlapping findings in the same phase are suppressed for 8 s.
overloadOverlay: Marking: historical zone and counted players at {time}. Green: attacking team; blue: defenders.
overloadReference: Reception: {events} · Possession phase {phase}. Zone observed from {start} to confirmation at {confirmed}.
assistantHint: Answers use only events available at the paused replay time. Name a player to narrow the scope.
questionPlaceholder: Which switches did Theo Wolf play?
preferenceHint: Choose favourites independently. Watch your player with one click.
fanPreferenceHint: Favourite moments shows scenes for your team OR your player. Turn it off to see both teams.
preferencesTemporary: Preferences last only for this visit because browser storage is unavailable.
fanCaution: This is a short simulated match. These moments do not prove how good a team or player is.
fanAssistantHint: Team shortcuts use your favourite team. Player questions use the selected player; a name in your question overrides that selection. Answers stop at the paused replay time.
fanWhy.pressing_escape: The ball gets away from nearby opponents. This can give the team more time to build its next attack.
fanWhy.switch_of_play: Moving the ball to the other side can give a teammate more room when one side is crowded. It does not necessarily create a scoring chance.
fanWhy.local_overload: Having more teammates nearby can offer more passing options. An opponent can still block the route to a teammate.
emptyFavorites: No confirmed moments for your favourites at this time. Turn off the favourites filter to see all moments.
